input.summary: Limit the no-consent assignment exception to AbbVie and bar Harpoon from assigning to a Competitor.
input.comment: [Playbook] We keep our right to assign to an Affiliate or successor without consent, but Harpoon's assignments should require our consent (not to be unreasonably withheld, as Section 13.4.1 already provides) and should never be made to a Competitor. Happy to discuss a notice-based mechanic for Harpoon successor assignments as a fallback.

ops.oldText: provided that either Party may make such an assignment without the other Party's consent to its Affiliate or to a successor, whether in a merger, sale of stock, sale of assets or any other transaction, of the business to which this Agreement relates.
ops.newText: provided that AbbVie may make such an assignment without Harpoon's consent to its Affiliate or to a successor, whether in a merger, sale of stock, sale of assets or any other transaction, of the business to which this Agreement relates, and in no event shall Harpoon assign this Agreement to a Competitor.
